meta.description: Build sequence logos from aligned DNA, RNA, or protein motifs using ggseqlogo (R), Logomaker (Python), or WebLogo with explicit bits vs probability encoding, background-frequency correction, custom alphabets, and multi-logo stacking. Use when visualizing motif PWMs (TF binding, splice sites, CRISPR spacers), aligned-position composition, or comparing two motif sets.
meta.execution_note: Executed 7/7 inputs. R 4.4.3 via r.sh (ggseqlogo 0.2.2, ggplot2 4.0.3), Windows venv (logomaker 0.8.7, pandas 3.0.6, matplotlib 3.11.2, weblogo 3.9.0), WSL science/dv-cli (WebLogo 3.7.12, Ghostscript 10.08, pdftoppm). Every code block of SKILL.md and the shipped example ran; outputs were checked numerically against an independent IC computation on synthetic planted motifs (n=5/20/200/2000, DNA/RNA/protein, GC-rich background) and JASPAR MA0106.3, and 30+ PNG/PDFs were opened. No __pycache__ in the external clone.

scientific_integrity.detail: Citations (Schneider 1986/1990, Crooks 2004, Wagih 2017, Tareen & Kinney 2020, Dey 2018) are real and the quantitative thresholds (2 bits DNA, 4.32 bits protein) verified; no fabricated results.

practice_boundaries.detail: Motif visualization only; nothing diagnostic or prescriptive.

methodological_ground.detail: The methodology (relative entropy against a background, small-sample correction) is principled and works on the Logomaker and WebLogo routes; the defect is a nonexistent ggseqlogo argument, recorded as P0, and a reversed bias direction, recorded as P1.

code_usability.detail: All SKILL.md R, Python and bash blocks parse and ran. Undefined variables (seqs_a, genome_composition, protein_pwm) are placeholders; the shipped example's missing inputs are a P1.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 3, correctness 1, appropriateness 3. Three routes and a sensible bits/probability/weight framing, but the ggseqlogo background parameter does not exist, the bias direction is stated backwards, and the Logomaker/WebLogo small-sample handling is not what the Schneider reference implies.

reliability.note: Failure-mode table catches real traps (transposed matrix, unequal length, N too small) with accurate fixes for the first two; the RNA-box mode is stale and the n=1 fabricated 2-bit fallback is not mentioned.

performance_context.note: 278-line SKILL.md plus a 86-line usage guide that largely repeats it; no references/ layer but modest size.

agent_usability.note: Goal/Approach headers and a decision table help, but an agent following the ggseqlogo block ends with an uncorrected figure it believes is corrected; undefined seqs_a, seqs_b, genome_composition, protein_pwm, ctcf_seqs in the blocks and the example.

human_usability.note: Prompts are natural, tips are short; the PWM-orientation tip is vague ('rows or columns differently').

security.note: No credentials, no network, no shell beyond weblogo; example writes PDFs into the cwd.

maintainability.note: Version stamped, but 'ggseqlogo 0.2 tested' cannot be true for bg_freq; Streptomyces composition (.18/.32) is a 64% GC genome, Streptomyces is about 72%.

agent_specific.note: Trigger description is precise and all five Related Skills exist; the description promises background-frequency correction that the primary tool does not perform.

key_strengths: ggseqlogo, Logomaker and WebLogo all draw correct logos: column IC equals an independent computation, planted letters dominate, and a real JASPAR TP53 PFM reproduces its consensus AACATGCCCGGGCATGTC in every route.
The bits vs probability framing, the 2 / 4.32 bit maxima and the transposed-matrix and unequal-length failure modes are accurate and the errors they predict reproduce.
Logomaker background= and WebLogo --composition genuinely implement background-corrected IC (relative entropy), matching an independent calculation.
Cross-references (chip-seq/motif-analysis, atac-seq/footprinting, clip-seq/clip-motif-analysis, alignment/multiple-alignment, color-palettes) all exist; no shipped file is missing.

recommendations.title: ggseqlogo bg_freq does not exist; background silently ignored
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md (twice), usage-guide.md and examples/seqlogo_phd.R call ggseqlogo(..., bg_freq = ...) and the example titles the result 'human bg'; heights are identical with and without it (max diff 0), ggplot2 only prints 'Ignoring unknown parameters: bg_freq'. The description's 'background-frequency correction' therefore fails on the primary tool and yields a figure labelled as corrected that is not.
recommendations.root_cause: ggseqlogo 0.2.2 has no background argument (ggseqlogo(data, facet, scales, ncol, nrow, ...) and geom_logo have none; computeBits uses log2(N) and only the e_n term).
recommendations.fix: Remove bg_freq from ggseqlogo calls; for a non-uniform background compute relative-entropy heights yourself and pass them with method = 'custom' (or use Logomaker background= / WebLogo --composition), verify the change numerically, and drop 'human bg' from titles unless applied.

recommendations.title: Bias direction of uniform-background error is reversed
recommendations.problem: Text says a GC-preferring motif in a GC-poor genome is overestimated and an A-rich motif in an AT-rich genome underestimated; for a fully conserved G (bg 0.21) uniform gives 2.000 vs 2.252 (under), for a fully conserved A (bg 0.29) 2.000 vs 1.786 (over).
recommendations.root_cause: The sign of log2(p/q) was reasoned backwards in the 'Background Composition Correction' and failure-mode sections.
recommendations.fix: State that uniform bg understates conservation of bases rarer than 0.25 and overstates it for commoner bases; fix the Streptomyces figures (about 0.14/0.36).

recommendations.title: Small-sample correction differs across the three tools and is undocumented
recommendations.problem: One fully conserved n=5 column reads 1.567 bits (ggseqlogo, Schneider e_n, sequences only), 0.553 (Logomaker default pseudocount=1), 1.136 (WebLogo default Dirichlet prior); ggseqlogo's matrix route gives 2.000. The Skill only says 'Schneider correction ... via small-N tools' and 'small-sample correction differs'.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill treats 'small-sample correction' as one thing and does not say which tool does what by default.
recommendations.fix: Add a per-tool table (ggseqlogo sequences: e_n, matrix: none; Logomaker: pseudocount=1 default, none for e_n; WebLogo: prior weight) and a Logomaker snippet with pseudocount=0 plus explicit e_n subtraction; recommend feeding sequences to ggseqlogo when N is small.

recommendations.title: Logomaker blocks: blank figure and 0.911-bit 'fully conserved'
recommendations.problem: The SKILL block creates fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,2)) but calls Logo without ax=ax, so figsize is ignored and a blank figure stays open; its 10-count all-A column reads 0.911 bits because transform_matrix defaults to pseudocount=1, not the 2 bits the text states.
recommendations.root_cause: Block not run against the library; pseudocount default not mentioned.
recommendations.fix: Pass ax=ax, set pseudocount explicitly, and note the default; replace the unavailable font.

recommendations.title: Shipped example cannot run and mislabels its figures
recommendations.problem: aligned_motif.fa and phospho_aligned.fa do not ship, ctcf_seqs/rest_seqs/gata1_seqs are never defined, titles claim 'human bg' and fixed N values.
recommendations.root_cause: Example written as a template without fixtures or derived labels.
recommendations.fix: Ship a small planted FASTA, derive N from the data and label only the background actually applied.

recommendations.title: Stale or inexact API claims
recommendations.problem: Logo(matrix_type=...) does not exist (TypeError); 'RNA U renders as box' did not reproduce; the matrix-orientation comment for ggseqlogo is reversed; 'EDLogo' is equated with Logomaker's weight matrix and a PSSM is routed through counts->weight; 'Arial Rounded MT Bold' is not on most systems.
recommendations.root_cause: Statements written from memory, not run.
recommendations.fix: Correct each line or delete it; name the real EDLogo tool if kept.

recommendations.title: n=1 drawn at fabricated 2 bits; WebLogo dna-on-RNA drops U; gs missing
recommendations.problem: ggseqlogo sets all zero-IC columns to 2 bits with only a warning; the Skill's WebLogo command hard-codes --sequence-type dna and on RNA input silently drops U (IC inflated 1.884 vs 0.964 bits at a column with 97 U); pip weblogo pdf/png/svg needs Ghostscript on Windows (exit 1 without it).
recommendations.root_cause: Edge cases and a dependency omitted from Prerequisites.
recommendations.fix: Warn against n<5, tell the reader to pass --sequence-type rna for U data, and list Ghostscript under Prerequisites.
